# cuda_memtest (ComputationalRadiationPhysics/cuda_memtest e94e1ee, dev, version 1.2.3): the
# open-source CUDA memory tester (the memtest86 algorithms on a GPU), built and run unmodified
# on the simulated nvidia/rtx3060. There is no card's output to compare with: a clean run must
# exit 0 with no error reported and print its marker; a run with a memory cell stuck at 1
# (`vgpu fault stuck`, offset in bytes from the start of device memory) must report the error
# and exit non-zero (--exit_on_error). Columns: name | arguments | fault | marker.
# Memory is limited to a few MB (--max_num_blocks) because the simulator runs on the CPU.
# Left out: test 6 (moving inversions, 32 bit patterns), about 45 s per MB; test 10 at its
# default iteration count (270 s for 4 MB), run instead with --num_iterations 2; and test 9,
# the bit fade test, which sleeps for minutes and is disabled by default.
patterns|--max_num_blocks 4 --num_passes 1 --disable_test 6 --disable_test 10 --exit_on_error|clean|Test8 finished
mapped|--mappedMem --max_num_blocks 2 --num_passes 1 --disable_test 6 --disable_test 10 --exit_on_error|clean|Test8 finished
stress|--stress --max_num_blocks 4 --num_iterations 2 --num_passes 1|clean|Test10 finished
stuck-cell|--max_num_blocks 4 --num_passes 1 --disable_test 6 --disable_test 10 --exit_on_error|stuck:0x100000|
